nina: idea: small "per-model health" pill in console — shows tokens, cache credits, est cost/1k for 1h window.
matt: ok but we must avoid heavy CH queries on page load.
anya: show a confidence dot if sampling <25%.
ops-bot: FYI model_burn_agg sampling_rate=0.12 for many tenants.
nina: plan: streaming upsert to redis from CH, TTL 30s; console backend read once per session.
matt: include quota_limited flag (router emits quota_event count). badge links to quota timeline.
anya: rollout to internal tenants first, track expand CTR and error rate.
nina: I'll write RFC. matt to prototype endpoint /internal/console/v1/model_health. ops-bot: deploy queued: feature/model-pill -> staging 2026-03-24T09:00:00Z
